title: A site_brief row whose worker died with tracy-web while placing the words says what reached the site, and a second press does not write over it
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at a Postgres the tests may write to, run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-build.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: 'a worker that died while placing words that reached the site says they are partly in, not that none are' passes: a stale `applying` row with timings.applyIds settles as state `applied` with error LOST_PART ('…only part of them reached the site…'), keeps its applyIds, and a second start() of the same site answers {started: false} and calls neither prepare nor apply.

'a worker that died as placing began, before any write was kept, does not claim the site is untouched' passes: a stale `applying` row with no apply id settles `failed` with LOST_PLACING ('…may still have the template’s own words').
'an open row whose worker died with the process is not held for ever' still passes: a stale `preparing` row settles `failed` with LOST_WORK.

'a worker that died after a write that reused an apply id says the words are partly in' passes: a stale `applying` row whose timings carry only reusedApplyIds ['dtrim-seed'] settles `applied` with LOST_PART (before review fix L1: `failed` with LOST_PLACING, which a second press would write over).
Before the fix (brief-build.js gate at 77545996c7): every stale open row, `applying` included, settled `failed` with LOST_WORK ('the site has the template’s own words') — 2 failures in this file.

A failed applying row without saved apply IDs records timings.lostFrom=applying; repeated Create and WO Retry both return started:false and preserve the original brief. Startup and poll recovery enforce the same fence.
A legacy failed LOST_PLACING row without timings.lostFrom also rejects a new Create attempt.

selectors.gate: createBriefBuilds().gate (apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-build.js), called by GET /api/sites/jobs/:id once the host says done

evidence: TCH #887: dev cowork.tracy.site 04/10/2026, e2e-jo.tracy.site — deploy #877 replaced tracy-web at 17:26:28Z during 'placing your text and pictures'; the row went failed with LOST_WORK at 17:30:30Z while /en/ already carried the customer's name, hero and services (qa/e2e-dev-2026-10-04, tasks/evidence/e2e-dev/2026-10-04/ F1).
fence: The row is the evidence: the case simulates the dead worker by writing the row a killed process leaves (stale updated_at), not by restarting a container. It does not read the site back, and the run is not resumed — a write that landed in the instant before its apply id was saved is covered only by the 'may' wording.

tests: a worker that died while placing words that reached the site
a worker that died as placing began
a worker that died after a write that reused an apply id
an open row whose worker died with the process
startup recovery with no saved apply ID prevents Create and WO retry from overwriting uncertain writes
a legacy uncertain-placement row without phase metadata cannot be replayed
